apiMessages.content: I want to double my training volume starting next week. Set it up.

Doubling overnight is a bad idea — that's how you get tendon/joint injuries, especially jumping straight into it. Two questions before I touch the schedule:

1. **Double how?** More sessions/week (3→6) or more volume per session (sets/exercises within Mon/Wed/Fri)?
2. **Why now?** Sudden 2x jumps are classic overuse-injury triggers. Standard guidance caps increases at ~10-20%/week.

If the real goal is faster strength gains, I'd recommend: add 1 session/week (4th day) or bump sets on key lifts by ~20%, not a flat double. Tell me which direction and I'll build it — otherwise give me explicit go-ahead to do a straight 2x and I'll execute as instructed.
